title: Base City
description: Base City went quiet. Cashy moves in to rebuild it, block by block. Explore the city in 3D.
line: A city that grows with Base. Orbit, zoom into the streets, or follow Cashy as he hops across the rooftops.
toast: Demo Payday: {amount} MSTR printed for {wallets} wallets
hint: Drag to orbit · Right-drag to pan · Scroll to zoom
hintKeys: Click the city, then W A S D to fly · R / F up and down
hintTouch: Drag to orbit · Pinch to zoom
fallback: Base City needs WebGL. Open this page in a recent browser on a device with graphics enabled.

tower.name: MSTR Tower
tower.text: The tallest building in Base City. On every Payday it throws MSTR stock certificates over the streets: 0.85% of every Cashy trade goes to holders, paid in MSTR.

plaza.name: Feel.cash Plaza
plaza.text: The central square of Base City. Every Cashy trade starts here, on Feel.cash.

cashy.name: Cashy
cashy.text: Base City’s own money. He walks the streets and hops across the rooftops. Cash in. MSTR out.

printer.name: Printer Factory
printer.text: Home of the Base Printer: how Cashy works, Payday history and Print my receipt. Coming soon.

arcade.name: Cashy Arcade
arcade.text: Cashy Tower is open: run, bounce off the walls and chain combos. How high can you go?

ipod.name: iPod store
ipod.text: Buy an iPod for cash. A crossover with IPOD, Feel.cash’s Apple-paired coin.

depot.name: Delivery Guy depot
depot.text: Delivery Guy delivers Cashy across Base City.

bank.name: Bank
bank.text: Holder ranks: banknote tiers based on how much and how long you hold.

plot.name: Open plot
plot.text: A cultural Base project that joins gets a building here, and its characters move into the streets.

reserved.name: Reserved building
reserved.text: Held for a Base project that joins Base City. It turns solid when the project moves in.

project.name: Base project
project.text: A Base community that moved in. Its characters walk the streets instead of the bots.

park.name: Base Park
park.text: A green square for community events, meetups and weekly calls.
